requirements.requirement: Fastest correct candidate and unseen-shape reference
requirements.finding: Full-output finite/NMSE comparison and strict median improvement required; unprofiled/unsafe shapes keep Prism. The direct RTX8000 cases numerically accepted custom candidates but their measured medians were slower, so these shapes select Prism. Full-model verification remains pending.

Uncaptured per-kernel and captured whole-graph completion samples invalidate persisted profiles. Device epoch and workload identity force cached graph recapture. Graph-cohort drift does not establish an individual kernel cause. Explicit startup calibration retests. Host controls pass; GPU replay proof pending.

SM75 backend initialization reserves128MiB for stream0 only when calibration or a measured faster CUTLASS route warrants it. Additional eligible mapped streams reserve before capture, at most8slabs/1GiB percontext. Stable addresses survive graphs; synchronized backend teardown frees them. Candidate launches allocate nothing. GPU load-memory proof pending.

Operator/calibration timing, sampled actual graph completion, route and actual workload, used/reserved scratch, shared-per-block storage and endpoint timing are instrumented. Direct graph-case timings were collected. Logical operand byte footprints are estimates; physical DRAM transactions and direct full-model throughput are not measured.
